repo_check.note: Started a new media-types-of-requests conspect because no existing matching conspect was found through the available GitHub search/check path.

MEDIA-R01-content-type-accept-media-type.meaning: HTTP media-type basics for requests: Content-Type vs Accept, request body format vs response format, MIME/media type strings, and negotiation headers.

MEDIA-R02-json-body-frombody-input-forma.meaning: JSON request bodies: application/json, [FromBody], model binding/input formatters, deserialization, body stream one-read semantics, and 415 Unsupported Media Type.

MEDIA-R03-form-urlencoded-multipart-from.meaning: Form request bodies: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data, [FromForm], form fields, file upload/IFormFile, boundaries and browser/Postman form submissions.

MEDIA-R04-endpoints-consumes-produces-er.meaning: Endpoint/API behavior: [Consumes]/[Produces], endpoint metadata, request/response examples, status codes such as 400/406/415, and practical debugging rules.

recommended_next_transcript_passes.why: Content-Type/Accept basics and JSON/[FromBody] request-body behavior form the first conceptual block.
Form/multipart plus endpoint metadata/errors form the practical request debugging tail.
